question: Estimate the annual revenue of Bharti Airtel India (telecom only).
idealClarificationQuestions: Airtel India mobile + broadband + enterprise? Yes — India ops only (Africa separate).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Airtel India mobile subscribers FY26: ~38 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus enterprise (B2B telecom, cloud, security): ~₹22,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: ARPU (Airtel slightly higher than Jio due to postpaid mix)

calculationFlow: Airtel India mobile subscribers FY26: ~38 crore.
ARPU (Airtel slightly higher than Jio due to postpaid mix): ~₹260/month.
Plus broadband (Xstream Fiber + AirFiber): ~30 lakh subs × ₹900/mo × 12 = ~₹3,200 Cr.
Plus enterprise (B2B telecom, cloud, security): ~₹22,000 Cr.
